faq_1_q: Do you offer services across Tanzania?
faq_1_a: Yes, we serve all across Tanzania. Transport costs depend on distance.
faq_2_q: How much does electrical installation cost?
faq_2_a: It depends on the size of the house or office. We come for a free inspection then provide an estimate.
faq_3_q: How long does it take to complete a job?
faq_3_a: A standard house (3 bedrooms) takes 2-3 days. Larger projects take 1-2 weeks.
faq_4_a: Yes, we provide 6 months warranty for every job. Equipment has manufacturer warranty.
faq_5_q: How can I make a booking?
faq_5_a: Fill the booking form on our website or call us at 0747 397 615.
faq_6_q: Do you do home CCTV installation?
faq_6_a: Yes, we do installation for homes, offices, industries, shops and more.
faq_7_a: You can purchase yourself or we can help you get quality equipment at good prices.
about_text_1: KASHOMBA ELECTRICAL SOLUTION is a leading provider of electrical and security solutions in Tanzania. With over 10 years of experience, we have built a reputation for quality, reliability, and professionalism.
about_text_2: Our team of certified electricians and technicians is dedicated to providing the highest quality service to our clients. We use only the best materials and equipment to ensure lasting results.
about_text_3: We pride ourselves on our customer service and our ability to complete projects on time and within budget. Whether you need a simple electrical repair or a complete security system installation, we are here to help.
mission_text: To provide reliable, safe, and affordable electrical and security solutions that meet the needs of our clients and exceed their expectations.
vision_text: To become the most trusted electrical and security solutions provider in Tanzania.
about_values_1: Quality - We never compromise on the quality of our work
about_values_2: Integrity - We are honest and transparent with our clients
about_values_3: Safety - Safety is our number one priority
about_values_4: Innovation - We use the latest technology and techniques
about_values_5: Customer Focus - Our clients are at the heart of everything we do
